（印：RECEIVED Aug 21 '30 Date August 30）

Herbert Edward Lencpart and N.N. Petoukhoff.

With reference to the attached letter of August
1, 1930 from the Netherlands Consul General re:
Herbert Edward Lencpart and N.N. Petoukhoff,
inquiries show that H.E. Lencpart is a Latvian,
37 years of age, bachelor, and has resided in Hongkong
for more than seven years and during that period he
has not been in Shanghai. Mr. N.N. Petoukhoff
is a Russian, 49 years of age, married and has resided
here for over six years. In October 1929 he intended
to go to the Dutch East Indies with Jakob Baldmann and
Mrs. O.N. Vorobieva as their impressario, but owing
to business matters he was compelled to remain in
Shanghai. He is very well known and is regarded as
a respectable person by the local White Russian
Community. There is nothing in Municipal Police
records to his detriment.

（印：1930年8月21日收 日期 8月30日）

赫伯特·爱德华·伦克帕特 (Herbert Edward Lencpart) 和 N.N. 佩图霍夫 (N.N. Petoukhoff)。

关于随附的1930年8月1日荷兰总领事就赫伯特·爱德华·伦克帕特和N.N. 佩图霍夫一事发出的信函，经查，H.E. 伦克帕特系拉脱维亚人，37岁，单身，已在香港居住七年有余，在此期间未曾到过上海。N.N. 佩图霍夫先生系俄罗斯人，49岁，已婚，在此居住已逾六年。1929年10月，他原计划作为雅各布·巴尔德曼 (Jakob Baldmann) 和 O.N. 沃罗比耶娃 (O.N. Vorobieva) 夫人的经理人前往荷属东印度，但因商务事宜被迫留在上海。他在当地白俄社区中广为人知，被视为体面人士。工部局警务处档案中没有任何对其不利的记录。

SHANGHAI, October 2nd 1929.

Sir,

You would greatly oblige me by letting me know whether
you possess any unfavourable information regarding Mr. Nicholas
Nicholaivitch PERHUKOFF, who has applied for a visa to the
Netherlands East Indies.

Mr. Pethukoff was born at Moscow on March 28th 1881
and is at present residing at 609A Avenue Joffre. So far he
has been in the employ of Messrs. Lennard & Veysseyre, French
architects, but he also has connections with various Russian
artists, for some of whom he is now going to act as an impres-
sario.

Thanking you in anticipation of the information,
which you may be able to place at my disposal,

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（签名）
Vice Consul,
for Consul General.

The Director of
Criminal Investigation,
Shanghai Municipal Police,

SHANGHAI.

先生，

如蒙告知您是否掌握有关尼古拉斯·尼古拉耶维奇·佩胡科夫 (Nicholas Nicholaivitch PERHUKOFF) 先生的任何不利信息，我将不胜感激，该先生已申请前往荷属东印度的签证。

佩胡科夫先生于1881年3月28日出生于莫斯科，现居霞飞路609A号。此前他受雇于法国建筑师伦纳德与韦西尔公司 (Messrs. Lennard & Veysseyre)，但他也与多位俄罗斯艺术家有联系，并将担任其中部分艺术家的经理人。

Commissioner,
Revenue Dept, S.M.C.

Dear Sir,
The undermentioned Messrs. A.E.David, S.P.
Tsirentschikoff and N.N.Petukhoff have formed a Company under
the style of
"FIVE DOLLARS TRIPS"
for the purpose of promoting facilities of travel by sea to
Europe and America to all persons intending to make such voyages.
It is proposed to effect this plan through the
medium of circulation of certain definite number of tickets good
for any class on steamer. The cost of such ticket to be $5. (Five
Dollars Mex.) each respectively.
The Company's initial capital is $5000. and all
partners are prepared to assume the responsibility for its
activities.
In view of the foregoing, we beg to apply for the
licence to circulate the tickets in question in the International
Settlement, where it is intended to establish the head office
of the Company.
Should the required licence be granted the Company
will be registered at the British Consulate and at the Bureau
for Foreign Affairs.
Yours faithfully,
(Sd) A.E.David,

(Sd) S.P.Tsirentschikoff, 196 Seymour Rd.
(Sd) N.N.Petukhoff, 18 Tracey Terrace

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. I. D. REGISTRY CENTRAL P.B. 93 Date March 15, 1929）

Subject (in full) Proposed new lottery company.

Made by D. I. Robertson. Forwarded by J.W. Owens A.B. Pol

With reference to the letter dated March 8, 1929
from Mr. A.E. David re "Five Dollar Trips", inquiries go
to show that Mr. A.E. David, Mr. S.P. Tsirentschikoff and
Mr. N. N. Petukhoff, the latter two gentlemen are respected
members of the local White Russian Community, have agreed
to form a company the name of which has not yet been
decided. The capital of the proposed company is $5,000.00
furnished by Mr. A.E. David and the office of the concern
will be situated at 74 Szechuen Road. In the absence of
anything definite having so far been decided upon by the
promoters it is somewhat difficult to understand the exact
nature of the business, but the following is the gist of the
scheme as outlined by Mr. A.E. David.

On the company being formed it is proposed to issue
bonds in serial number at $5.00 each. The number of every
bond thus sold will take part in a drawing and the holder
of the winning number will be entitled to a free passage
to Europe or the equivalent in cash less 15% which the
company will deduct as commission. It is proposed that
should
a drawing take place on the sale of every 200 tickets,
which means that from every $1000.00 collected from the
sale of bonds the company deduct 15% commission. The time,
date and place of drawing will be notified in the local
Chinese and foreign press. It is proposed that Mr.
Tsirentschikoff and Mr. N.N. Petukhoff, assisted by a
Chinese staff, will be in charge of the sale of the bonds
while Mr. A.E. David will nominally be in charge of affairs
and the company will be registered in his name at the
British Consulate and at the Bureau for Foreign Affairs.

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事调查处登记室 中央政治部 93 日期 1929年3月15日）

主题（全称） 拟议的新彩票公司。

制作人 D. I. Robertson。 转发人 J.W. Owens 助理总监 政治部

关于1929年3月8日 A.E. David 先生就“五美元旅行”一事发出的信函，经查，A.E. David 先生、S.P. Tsirentschikoff 先生和 N. N. Petukhoff 先生（后两位是当地白俄社区中受人尊敬的成员）已同意组建一家公司，其名称尚未确定。拟议公司的资本为5,000.00美元，由 A.E. David 先生提供，公司办事处将设在四川路74号。由于发起人迄今尚未做出任何具体决定，因此很难确切理解该业务的性质，但以下是 A.E. David 先生概述的计划要点。

公司成立后，计划发行序列号为每份5.00美元的债券。每售出一份此类债券的号码都将参与抽奖，中奖号码的持有人有权获得免费前往欧洲的通行证，或扣除15%佣金后的等额现金，这15%将由公司作为佣金扣除。计划规定，
每售出200张票进行一次抽奖，
这意味着从每1000.00美元的债券销售收入中，公司扣除15%的佣金。抽奖的时间、日期和地点将在当地中英文报刊上公布。计划由 Tsirentschikoff 先生和 N.N. Petukhoff 先生在中国职员的协助下负责债券的销售，而 A.E. David 先生将名义上负责事务，公司将以他的名义在英国领事馆和外事局注册。

BUREAU OF EASY TRIPS.

Temporary address:
c/o A.E. David
74 Szechuen Road.

PARTNERS:
Messrs. A.E. David, 74 Szechuen Road, S.P.
Tsirentschikoff, 196 Seymour Road and N.N. Petukhoff, 18
Tracey Terrace, on the strength of a special agreement
concluded between them are establishing a Company in Shanghai
whose office will be known as the "BUREAU OF EASY TRIPS".

Rules and Regulations governing the sale of
and the drawing of bonds.
--------------------------

I. Partners are responsible for the activities and losses
of the Company in the following manner:- A. E. David is responsible
only for the declared capital of $5.000.00 which belongs to him,
and that only in the event of there being no funds belonging to
the Company or to any of the other two partners; he does not bear
any other responsibility. Messrs. S. P. Tsirentschikoff and
N.N. Petukhoff are fully responsible both before the authorities
and their clients for all activities, transactions and losses of
the Company, whichever these may prove to be.

2. The Office of the Company will be opened and transactions
will begin upon a licence being obtained from the Shanghai
Municipal Council of the International Settlement.

3. The transactions of the Company will consist in
circulating bearer bonds valued at $5.00 both at the Office of
the Company and through its agents among persons desiring to
travel to Europe and America, in China and to other countries,
and in securing reservations for the winners on steamers for
which tickets will be fully paid up by the Company.

4. Every bond sold participates in the drawing held for
some one respective journey to any of the countries.

5. The number of bonds circulated for every Drawing will
be as follows:- 400 bonds for Europe, 270 for America and 30
for China. All bonds will be good for a First Class journey
on any steamer and at any time after the drawing takes place.
In future, when the Company's business is extended,
journeys will be arranged for Second and Third Class on the
same principle.

6. All sums received from the sale of bonds are immediately
placed in one of the Shanghai banks on the Company's Current
Account on condition that the Company can draw that money out
only after the drawing takes place and that the Cheque for the
amount of the First Prize is made out in the name of the
Steamship Company concerned or if no journey is to be taken
in the name of the bearer of the winning bond.
pages.zh:
便捷旅行局。

临时地址：
转交 A.E. David
四川路 74 号。

合伙人：
A.E. David 先生，上海公共租界四川路 74 号；
S.P. Tsirentschikoff 先生，西摩路 196 号；以及
N.N. Petukhoff 先生，特雷西公寓 18 号，
依据他们之间缔结的一项特别协议，正在上海设立一家公司，其办事处定名为“便捷旅行局”。

关于债券销售及抽奖的规则与章程。
--------------------------

一、合伙人按以下方式对公司的活动和损失承担责任：- A. E. David 仅对其名下的申报资本 5,000.00 美元承担责任，且仅在公司或其他两位合伙人名下均无资金的情况下承担此责任；他不承担其他任何责任。S. P. Tsirentschikoff 先生和 N.N. Petukhoff 先生就公司的所有活动、交易和损失，无论结果如何，均须向当局及客户承担全部责任。

2. 公司在获得上海公共租界工部局颁发的执照后，将开设办事处并开始营业。

3. 公司的业务包括：向希望前往欧洲、美洲、中国及其他国家旅行的人士，通过公司办事处及其代理人，发行面值 5.00 美元的无记名债券；并为中奖者预订轮船舱位，船票费用由公司全额支付。

4. 每张售出的债券均可参与针对前往任一国家的某次特定旅程举行的抽奖。

5. 每次抽奖发行的债券数量如下：- 欧洲方向 400 张，美洲方向 270 张，中国方向 30 张。所有债券在抽奖结束后，均可用于在任何时间乘坐任何轮船的头等舱旅行。将来，随着公司业务扩展，将按同样原则安排二等和三等舱的旅行。

6. 出售债券所得的所有款项应立即存入上海的一家银行，列入公司的往来账户，条件是：公司仅在抽奖结束后方可提取该笔款项；且头奖金额的支票须开具给相关轮船公司，若无实际行程，则开具给中奖债券持有人。

pages.en:
- 2 -

The other sums will be drawn by the Company in
the usual way.

7. In the event of fluctuations of the rates of exchange
in £ and in Gold Dollars as well as in the cost of steamship
passages the number of bonds to be issued may be altered
either way i.e. increased or reduced.

8. The Drawing takes place in the presence of a representative
of the Shanghai Municipal Council of the International
Settlement, the Company's representative and not less than three
bond holders for which respective Drawing these bonds had been
sold. The time and place of the Drawing to be announced in
two newspapers.

9. Nos. of the winning bonds to be published in the
newspapers and detailed lists to be exhibited in the office of
the Company.

10. On presentation of the bond at the Office of the Company,
the winner makes a written application giving the time of
intended departure and the name of the steamer by which such
bondholder desires to travel. If no accommodation is available
on that particular steamer the Company reserves the right to
offer the winner accommodation on another steamer at the
bondholder's choice sailing at about the same time.

11. If the winner for some reason or other is unable to
make the journey he is entitled to the equivalent of the cost
of the respective journey in cash after the Company deducts
15% of its expenses.

12. In addition to the First Prize all bonds whose terminal
figure happens to be the same as that of the winning bond parti-
cipate in the drawing and such bondholders get their $5.00
refunded.
Example:- First Prize No. 127 - all bonds with the
terminal figure 7 get the refund.

13. The date of the Drawing is to be indicated on every bond.

14. In the event of it being impossible to circulate all
the bonds of the respective Drawing prior to the date indicated
on the bonds, the Company reserves the right to postpone the
Drawing for a period not later than one month or to hold the
Drawing after the exclusion of all the unsold bonds.

15. None of the partners of the Company or the firm have a
right to participate in the winnings or to retain in their
names any of the unsold bonds.

7. 若英镑和金美元汇率波动，以及轮船票价发生变动，可相应调整（即增加或减少）拟发行的债券数量。

8. 抽奖将在上海公共租界工部局代表、公司代表以及不少于三名所售债券对应本次抽奖的债券持有人的见证下进行。抽奖的时间和地点将在两家报纸上公布。

9. 中奖债券号码将在报纸上刊登，详细名单将在公司办事处张贴公示。

10. 中奖者向公司办事处出示债券时，需提交书面申请，注明预期出发时间及希望乘坐的轮船名称。若该特定轮船无空位，公司有权为中奖者提供另一艘大致同一时间开航的轮船舱位，由债券持有人选择。

11. 若中奖者因故无法成行，有权在公司扣除 15% 的费用后，获得相当于该次旅程费用的现金等价物。

12. 除头奖外，所有末位数字与中奖债券相同的债券也参与抽奖，此类债券持有人可获退还 5.00 美元。
例如：- 头奖号码为 127 - 所有末位数字为 7 的债券均可获退款。

13. 每张债券上须注明抽奖日期。

14. 若在债券注明的日期之前无法售出该次抽奖的所有债券，公司有权将抽奖推迟不超过一个月，或在剔除所有未售出的债券后举行抽奖。

15. 公司的任何合伙人或商号均无权参与中奖分配，或以其名义保留任何未售出的债券。
